status: local architectural contract and dispatch hold; not installed into common harness

rules.requirement: A contaminated session and outputs derived from unauthorized bodies cannot qualify independent evidence. Retain historical records and quarantine derived artifacts.

Replacement uses a new native conversation, no resume/fork/full-history transfer. Carry only approved intent, decisions, task dependencies, source locators, bounded source snapshots and immutable evidence references.
A new pane, Git worktree or prompt prohibition is not an access-control proof. Check actual native tool execution and host effects independently.

Admit only when every enabled retrieval/delegation channel is proven constrained to the task scope, or is proven disabled. Unknown controls hold dispatch; shell proof does not qualify MCP/apps/web/session tools.
Request additional context by typed locator and purpose. Owner qualifies and supplies the minimal exact revision/digest; no automatic body ingestion from a discovered path.
If an unauthorized body is observed, interrupt immediately, close assignment, quarantine derived output, preserve stable Work/Task and history, and repeat fresh admission.
Qualify each native environment separately. One Codex shell proof does not prove other Codex channels, Antigravity, Muse, Claude, Grok CLI or Hermes.

scopeExpansionAuthority: User approved Work scope and existing source/native owners; common contract or permission grants retain separate approval boundary
